title: Equal-capacity causal fading-memory search on fresh CALIFA fossil histories and stellar kinematics
implementation_correction_scope: First, accept V1200 FITS column names case-insensitively because the README uses Vp/Sp/DVp/DSp while the tables expose VP/SP/DVP/DSP. Second, after only 9 of 64 exploration galaxies passed all three annuli but 26 passed the unchanged primary annulus, preserve the frozen 45-object formal gate and allow the already-frozen primary search to run diagnostically on at least 20 primary-valid galaxies; unavailable radial replays are marked insufficient and neither track can promote. Third, pass the required artifact label to the already-existing content-hash validator. These corrections change no formula, candidate, identity, role, fold, response value, quality threshold, confirmation boundary, result value, or promotion gate.

implementation_correction_history.scope: Case-insensitive V1200 FITS column lookup after the official README/binary-table capitalization mismatch.
Primary-only diagnostic while retaining the failed all-annulus formal quality gate and disabling promotion.
Supply required labels to content-hash validation; no scientific computation changes.

response_access_incident: The first post-freeze exploration acquisition downloaded all 64 permitted files into the untracked cache and aborted on a case-sensitive schema check, writing no response artifact. The case-corrected acquisition queried the same 64 files and wrote a receipt showing 9 all-annulus valid galaxies, below the 45-object gate. No confirmation file was queried. The diagnostic correction reuses only those same exploration bytes and retains 26 primary-valid galaxies without changing the formal INCONCLUSIVE_QUALITY outcome.
hypothesis: A single causal positive fading kernel applied to a measured fossil record of earlier stellar configurations predicts fresh CALIFA stellar dynamical speeds beyond instantaneous stellar baryons and strong ordinary population, morphology, and structure controls.

discovery_policy.universal_gravity_track: Require one unchanged stable causal-memory family to improve the primary dynamical observable, both radial replays, all broad mass and fossil-age halves, full-search nulls, and local/static gates.
discovery_policy.phenomenon_publication_track: Independently retain any reproducible relation between a frozen fossil-history functional and kinematics that beats strong ordinary controls on its measured domain, even if it is not gravity or cannot solve the dark-matter problem.

theory.response_rule: For fossil lookback fractions f_j at ages tau_j, Q_K=sum_j f_j K(tau_j)/sum_j f_j. At fixed disk-scaled radius, log10(v)=log10(v_instantaneous)+0.5*log10(mu), where mu=exp[s*A*Q_K*W(g_bar)] and W=1/(1+(g_bar/a_transition)^p).
theory.static_limit: The extra response is exactly zero when the measured configuration-change history is zero; a frozen no-memory control sets Q_K=0.
theory.causality: All kernels have support only at nonnegative lookback time, K(0)=1, K(t)>=0, and no future or advanced values.
theory.fading_and_stability: Every admitted kernel is nonincreasing, absolutely integrable on [0,infinity), and has finite nonnegative L1 norm. Exponential mixtures have an explicit stable first-order state realization; the other kernels remain phenomenological response functions until an action or state realization is derived.
theory.local_limit: A low-acceleration window and a conservative Solar fractional source-change proxy are applied to the same unchanged candidate; the predicted one-AU fractional response must remain below the frozen bound.

external_constraints.label: Mashhoon, Nonlocal Gravity
external_constraints.scope: Known causal constitutive-kernel framework for nonlocal gravity.

external_constraints.label: Rahvar and Mashhoon, Observational Tests of Nonlocal Gravity
external_constraints.scope: Known spatial nonlocal kernel tested on galaxy rotation curves and clusters; a control against claiming kernel use itself as novel.

external_constraints.label: Sanchez et al., Pipe3D CALIFA dataproducts
external_constraints.scope: Public CALIFA DR2 stellar-population and fossil-history products for 200 V500 datacubes.

external_constraints.label: Falcon-Barroso et al., CALIFA stellar kinematics
external_constraints.scope: Separate public V1200 stellar velocity and dispersion maps for 300 CALIFA galaxies.

external_constraints.label: de Amorim et al., PyCASSO database
external_constraints.scope: Prior resolved CALIFA population-history catalog and evidence that age, surface density, SFR, and kinematics coexist as ordinary galaxy observables.

prior_equivalence: The single exponential kernel is a standard linear fading-memory control, not a new formula.
The stretched exponential, finite positive exponential mixture, and integrable power-law tail are known response-kernel families, not historical novelties.

Combining a resolved fossil-history functional, a low-acceleration window, and a gravitational response is a potentially distinct synthesis only; algebraic non-equivalence is not evidence of historical novelty.
A relation between stellar populations and stellar kinematics can arise from morphology, asymmetric drift, feedback, selection, or shared spectral systematics rather than gravitational memory.
claim_limits: Pipe3D SFH planes are luminosity fractions of fitted simple stellar populations, not direct mass-weighted histories of every baryonic component.
Stellar mass and an r-band disk scale omit direct atomic, molecular, ionized-gas, and remnant mass maps.
CALIFA V500 population fits and V1200 kinematics are separate public products but share galaxies, telescope, and some astrophysical systematics.
Stellar v_rms is not the circular speed of every star and is not a lensing observable.

A positive result is first a CALIFA phenomenon lead; a paper claim requires unchanged cross-source replication and a gravity claim requires later galaxy, cluster, lensing, local, stability, and cosmology gates.

observable_lineage.baryons: Pipe3D stellar mass plus SDSS r-band disk scale, axis ratio, bulge fraction, and disk fraction, all frozen before any V1200 values are read.
observable_lineage.history_state: Thirty-nine Pipe3D SSP-age luminosity-fraction planes summarized globally and in fixed disk-scaled inner and outer regions before response access.
observable_lineage.response: Exact exploration-only V1200 stellar velocity and velocity-dispersion maps opened after both freezes and reduced to preregistered disk-scaled v_rms observables.

sample.rule: Intersect only predictor identities with an advertised V1200 filename, exclude every predecessor name and coordinate, enforce frozen disk/history quality, split five stellar-mass strata, seal three HMAC-ranked identities per stratum, and assign all other identities to five folds before opening any V1200 file.

candidate_generator.algorithm: numpy.random.Generator(PCG64) with four exactly balanced positive causal fading-kernel niches before response-independent equivalence, normalization, monotonicity, integrability, positivity, and local filters
candidate_generator.synthetic_injection_rule: One exact target-blind, nondegenerate, material-strength admissible index per niche, frozen before response access.

evaluation.baseline_instantaneous_baryonic: training-only affine relation in sqrt(G*Mstar/(2.2*h_r)) with one universal calibration per outer fold
evaluation.baseline_flexible_nuisance: fixed ridge regression on mass, disk scale, surface density, SFR, mean age, metallicity, disk axis ratio, inclination, bulge fraction, disk fraction, redshift, and predeclared interactions
evaluation.primary_loss: galaxy-balanced out-of-fold mean squared log10 stellar v_rms in the 1.3-2.3 disk-scale annulus
